name: Ai o Kuraeba Higan made
original_name: 愛を喰らえば彼岸まで
source:
The main character, Izumo Sazanami, is homosexual.
While he's attracted to men, he's averse to women and heterosexuality.
As he grows up and matures, Izumo realizes that he's a minority.
In junior high school, Izumo made a friend; a best friend, even.
Then, naturally, he fell in love with him...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5442]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
主角涟出云是一名同性恋。

他被男性吸引，却对女性和异性恋怀有抵触。

随着逐渐长大、成熟，出云意识到自己属于少数。

初中时，出云交到了一个朋友，甚至可以说是挚友。

然后，自然而然地，他爱上了对方…

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5442]NovelGame[/url]]
